resources.string: Active — Instagram is blocked.\nRemovable only from a computer via ADB.
Not yet set as Device Owner.\nRun the ADB command from the setup guide.
Blocks Instagram by returning to the home screen when it is opened.
To remove: connect to a computer and run\nadb shell dpm remove-active-admin com.block.instagramblocker/.AdminReceiver\nthen adb uninstall com.block.instagramblocker
